mcq.question: Why does `clean_name` avoid plain `str.title()` for names?

options.A: `title()` capitalises after apostrophes too, so `"john's"` becomes `"John'S"`

mcq.explanation: `str.title()` treats any non-letter as a word boundary, so it capitalises the letter after an apostrophe. `string.capwords` only splits on whitespace.

mcq.question: What does `'abc'.center(7, '*')` return?
mcq.explanation: `center` pads both sides to reach the width. 4 fill characters are split evenly, 2 on each side.
